verdict.rationale: Sift's docs list Account Takeover, Account Abuse (fake accounts), Promotion Abuse, Content Integrity and Payment Protection as product lines. Each gets an abuse-specific risk score so several fraud types can be fought at once. These scores feed the same Workflows, Review Queues and Decisions (e.g., Ban Account), which puts post-checkout surfaces in one scoring and management system. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of broader policy abuse (e.g., refund/return abuse) beyond promotions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-surface use.
